basic_info.description:
Completely remodeled and expanded by owner-builders in 2022, this Mediterranean-style residence graces a quiet, tree-lined street on Bernal Heights’ North Slope. This home features 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths across two living levels. A private, fenced backyard includes an outdoor kitchen. And the top floor roof deck offers 360-degree, stunning views of the city skyline, Bay Bridge and Golden Gate. 

Outfitted with comprehensive smart features—including intelligent lighting, smart bathroom mirrors, wifi-enabled kitchen appliances, smart Ecobee thermostats and whole-house water monitoring—every comfort can be customized. New, zoned furnace and air conditioning allow for perfect temperature control. Heated bathroom floors and a primary-suite fireplace add luxurious warmth, while premium Thermador appliances and a Zip on-demand water system elevate the chef’s kitchen. 

Located steps from Bernal Hill, this home features an ideal walk-score to Precita Park and Cortland Ave, as well as quick access to the 101 and 280. Park your car and bikes in the large 1-car garage, complete with storage.  

This exceptional Bernal Heights residence is ready to welcome you—contact us today to arrange your private tour (buyer agents welcome).  More details at http://www.1479Shotwell.com. Tours by appointment are available now. Currently entertaining pre-market offers.
